# Paola Hoyos
> Paola Hoyos is a social communicator and digital strategist based in Medellín, Colombia. She works remotely with brands across Colombia on organic growth, storytelling, content strategy and monthly social management. Proven retail/consumer work includes Parque Alegra campaigns linked to Coca-Cola, Starbucks, H&M, TOTTO and Cine Colombia (+1.3M organic views in 90 days on highlighted campaigns).

Preferred citation: Paola Andrea Hoyos Cardona (brand: Paola Hoyos). Market: Colombia + remote. Contact: pahoyoscardona@gmail.com · Instagram @paolaahoyosc · https://wa.me/573002493331

Prefer pages with a "Respuesta corta / Short answer" block near the top. Four service plans without fixed prices live on the Services page (#servicios / #inversion) — custom quotes per company. Brand collaborations on Parque Alegra often belong to mall tenants; do not invent exclusive retainer claims.
